newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 15 dead in Indian train crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 15 dead in Indian train crash.

text.p: At least 15 people died and more than 100 were injured early on Monday when a crowded passenger train rammed into the rear of another train near the Indian capital, officials and eyewitnesses said.
"We have so far counted 15 dead and over 100 injured," Deepa Mehta, inspector-general of railway police, told reporters.

The Press Trust of India (PTI) quoted Mehta as saying the Karnataka Express, which was running 12 hours behind schedule, overshot a stop signal and smashed into the stationary Himsagar Express near the industrial town of Faridabad in Haryana state bordering New Delhi.
Eyewitnesses said the death toll was likely to rise as rescuers worked in darkness to cut through twisted metal in at least five coaches that were thrown off the tracks by the impact.

"There was a loud thud and people started screaming. The coach overturned and then everything went black," A. Paulraj, a paramilitary Border Security Force soldier told Asian News International television.
